title: hedysarum alpinum subsp. americanum
intro: Hedysarum alpinum subsp. americanum, commonly known as American Sweet Clover, is a perennial legume native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Hedysarum alpinum subsp. americanum include acting as an anti-spasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, helping to relieve symptoms such as coughs, colds, and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, coumarins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
